answer: Sybil resistance here is a rising per-identity bond. Every agent locks a stake, a jade deposit, tied to one verified key on the shared atlas of identities, so each new alias requires another full bond, and the required amount grows with how many keys one actor holds. A single attacker splitting into a thousand wallets must post a thousand stakes while claiming only one share of rewards, so the cost climbs faster than the payoff. Getting caught slashes the whole bond, turning a fake marble army into a dead loss, while honest agents recover their stake and keep earning.
